data.name: Kamod
data.gender_notes: Kamod is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kamod is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kama' which means 'desire, love, passion, and pleasure'. The suffix 'od' in the name signifies 'god'. Thus, Kamod is considered as the god of love. The name Kamod carries the meaning “God of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kamod usually hope their child will grow to embody god of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kamod represents the divine force of love and passion. It signifies the deepest feelings of the heart and the intense longing for union with the divine.
data.etymology: Kamod belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamod total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kamod holds deep cultural significance in Hindu tradition. It is believed that the god Kamod bestows the blessings of love, passion, and pleasure upon his devotees. The name is often invoked during weddings and other auspicious occasions to encourage the feelings of love and relationship between people. In popular culture, Kamod is also known as Kamadeva or the god of love in Hindu mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kamod represents the divine energy of love that is present in all beings. It reminds us of the importance of love, not only in our personal relationships but also towards others and towards the Divine. The name encourages us to cultivate a deeper connection with the divine force of love within ourselves and around us. It is a reminder of the transformative power of love and the role it plays in our spiritual growth.
